scope: Managed core patch retirement audit against N.E.K.O 99b479a0
method: Enumerate each managed patch's touched source files.
Intersect them with upstream file changes from 6fccfb72..99b479a0.
For every overlap, inspect the semantic diff rather than treating file overlap as replacement evidence.
Require equivalent behavior and acceptance evidence before retirement.
